limits: The original transport ended early; the device progress file alone cannot satisfy the frozen protocol.
Terminal frozen state and self-reported completion were observed in the same sample; their temporal order is unknown.
The primary observer did not recheck process start time after reading UID; only the later fenced samples did.
All samples are discrete and do not cover the complete workload or prove absence of freezing between samples.
The user reported a phone freezing module; the observation did not independently identify its trigger.
No force-stop, uninstall, data clearing or change to another application was performed.
